title: Black Bean and Sweet Potato Quesadillas

source.name: USDA MyPlate Kitchen
source.credit: Bronson Wellness Center, Bronson Healthcare - Michigan

ingredients.name: sweet potato, cooked and cut into pieces

steps.instruction: Spray a medium pan with nonstick cooking spray.
Add 1 chopped onion and 1 clove of minced garlic and cook until soft.
Add 1 cooked sweet potato, 1 cup of black beans and 1/2 jalapeno pepper.
Add 1 1/2 teaspoons each of ground cumin and paprika.
Heat the mixture until just warm.
Top with 1/2 cup of baby spinach and 1/4 cup of cheddar cheese.
Top each one with a second tortilla.
Heat a pan on high heat and spray it with nonstick cooking spray.
Brown 1 quesadilla for 1 minute on one side.
steps.spoken: Brown 1 quesadilla for about 1 minute on one side. Then do the same with the other quesadillas, one at a time.

steps.instruction: Flip it and brown 1 minute more, until the cheese is melted.
steps.spoken: Flip it and brown it for about 1 more minute, until the inside is warm and the cheese is melted.
